findings.note: Independent audio recheck supports the stated 50% community / 20% investors / 30% team allocation and investors/team locked for at least one year. Preserve this historical pre-ICO statement; it does not establish implemented terms or execution.

Currency is pesos, not pieces. Keep the spoken 14,000 followed by the correction to 140,000 in the $100 example. The medium.en repeated-140 loop after 3838s is rejected; no repeated speech is added. Shorter small.en confirmation supports the pesos wording and final 140,000. Both passes suggest pagos tres punto cero for the omitted payment-system name, but the complete wording remains explicitly unclear. This illustrative conversion is not a verified historical or current exchange rate.

Audio supports 1.5% commission per payment as spoken, and money staked rather than money taken. Keep the speaker's profit wording but do not infer a net margin, annualized return or current fee schedule.

Audio supports the spoken 500-700 stake range, about 200 per month and 200-300 per month from a 700 stake. Stakes is a contextual reading supported by the later explicit stake wording. Correct text us rather than taxes. Preserve the explicit active-work/not-yield caveat. These are anecdotal speaker examples, not guaranteed or verified earnings.

The recheck supports the explicit assumption of not sub-second and probably a couple of seconds, dependent on the operation and still awaiting testing. Preserve all caveats; no measured benchmark or ready implementation is inferred. Lars is a contextual name correction; both models render Larsen.

The throughput assertion remains a historical speaker claim, not a measured result. The host waiting phrase is marked unclear: the newer passes suggest milliseconds but disagree on can/cannot, while the original says minute seconds. Do not substitute seconds or manufacture another latency claim. The reaction word foolish is retained because all three passes agree, without inferring speaker sentiment.
